title: Protocol to derive human trophoblast stem cells directly from primed pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Observe the morphology of hPSCs and confirm hPSCs at 80%–90% confluency under the microscope.
Remove the medium from culture plate (6 well).
Wash hPSCs with 1 mL DMEM/F12 basic medium per well.
Add 600 μL Accutase per well to dissociate into individual cells for 8 min at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Observe the hPSCs which are the single formation and floating after 8 minutes.
Add 600 μL DMEM/F12 basic medium into the well and pipette the cell suspension gently.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube and centrifuge cells at 200 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells with 1.5 mL mTeSR1 medium.
Add 10 μM Y27632 to the suspended cells.
Pipette the cells gently to ensure single-cell suspension.
Count the cell number using the cell count chamber with trypan blue.
Seed 4×10^5 cells per well of hPSCs in mTeSR1 medium plus 10 μM Y27632 on matrigel-coated 6-well plates at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove the mTeSR1 medium one day later (day 0).
Wash hPSCs with 1 mL DMEM/F12 basic medium per well.
Add 2 mL hTSC medium per well.
Observe the morphology of hPSCs.
Change the fresh hTSC medium every 2 days.
On day 3, ensure confluency of transdifferentiated cells reaches about 90–100%.
Remove the medium from the wells.
Add 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA per well for 8 minutes at 37°C.
Observe cell morphology under the microscope to confirm loosened cell-cell interactions.
Remove the EDTA and add 3 mL of fresh TSC medium to each well.
Pipette cells gently and passage them into a new Matrigel-coated 6-well plate at a 1:3 ratio.
Add 1 mL of fresh hTSC medium to each well after passaging.
Change the fresh hTSC medium every 2 days.
On day 5, repeat the EDTA treatment step for cell passage at a 1:3 ratio.
Observe the morphology of transdifferentiated cells on day 7–8 and confirm appearance of hTSC-like colonies.
Pick hTSC-like colonies for purification and characterization on day 10–12.
Remove medium from culture plates.
Add 1 mL of DMEM/F12 basic medium per well to wash cells.
Remove the DMEM/F12 basic medium and add 2 mL of fresh hTSC medium.
Wipe the microscope, disposable glass pipets, and surrounding environment with 75% alcohol.
Light an alcohol lamp next to the microscope.
Burn glass pipets into a vertical and sharp shape using the alcohol lamp.
Coat new 12-well plates with matrigel for at least 1 hour at 37°C.
Burn the glass pipets again using the alcohol lamp.
Open the plate.
Observe hTSC-like colonies under the microscope.
Gently scrape hTSC-like colonies from the well using the glass pipets.
Shake the culture plate to collect scraped colonies.
Transfer cell suspension to a new matrigel-coated 12-well plate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change fresh hTSC medium daily.
Scrape some non-hTS cells by the glass pipets.
Dissociate purified hTSC-like cells with TrypLE Express solution when they reach 80%-90% confluency, using 600 μL per well for 8-10 minutes at 37°C.
Collect cell suspension into 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes after dissociation.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 1 mL hTSC medium.
Pipette the cells gently.
Passage the cells in a new matrigel-coated 6-well plate at a 1:1 ratio.
Add fresh hTSC medium to a total of 2 mL per well in a 6-well plate.
Culture the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the fresh hTSC medium every day.
Passage routinely the purified human TSC-like cells using TrypLE Express every three days at a 1:3 ratio.
Aspirate the mTeSR1 medium.
Wash hPSCs with DMEM/F12 basic medium.
Add 2 mL hTSC medium plus 10 ng/mL BMP4 per well.
Change fresh hTSC medium plus 10 ng/mL BMP4 every 2 days.
Observe the morphology of the transdifferentiated cells on day 3.
Confirm appearance of hTSC-like colonies.
Passage cells at 90–100% confluency using 0.5 mM EDTA for 8 min at 37°C.
Change the fresh hTSC medium plus 10 ng/mL BMP4 every 2 days.
On day 5, passage the cells with 0.5 mM EDTA at a 1:3 ratio.
On day 10–12, passage the hTSC-like cells using TrypLE Express for 8 min at a 1:3 ratio.
Add fresh hTSC medium to a total of 2 mL per well in a 6-well plate and culture the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the fresh hTSC medium every day.
Routinely passage human TSC-like cells using TrypLE Express every three days at a 1:3 ratio.
Remove the medium from the well of hTSPS and hTSPSB cells.
Wash hPSCs with 1 mL DMEM/F12 basic medium per well and remove DMEM/F12 from the well.
Add 600 μL TrypLE Express per well for 8 min at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Shake the plate and add 600 μL DMEM/F12 basic medium into the well.
Pipette the cell suspension gently and transfer to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 5 min and remove the supernatant.
Add 1.5 mL hTSC medium and resuspend cells gently.
Seed the cells at a 1:3 ratio in a total of 2 mL hTSC medium per well on matrigel-coated 6-well plates at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the fresh hTSC medium every day.
Passage the hTSPS and hTSPSB cells using TrypLE Express every three days at a 1:3 ratio.
Repeat steps for cryopreservation when confluency reaches 80%-90%.
Add 1 mL Cell Banker 2 to resuspend cells.
Transfer the cell suspension to Cryotube vials.
Store the vial at -80°C and subsequently in liquid nitrogen.
Maintain hTSC morphology.
Express hTSC markers (GATA3/KRT7/TEAD4/TP63).
Differentiate into extravillous cytotrophoblast cells (EVT) and syncytiotrophoblast cells (STB).
Capture the morphology of hTSPS and hTSPSB cells using a microscope.
Validate the expression of hTSC markers GATA3/KRT7/TEAD4/TP63 using immunostaining.
Validate the expression of hESC marker OCT4 using immunostaining.
Remove the medium from hTSPS cells on the 6-well plate at 80%-90% confluency.
Wash the cells with DPBS.
Treat the cells with 600 μL TrypLE Express for 8 min at 37°C.
Add 600 μL DMEM/F12 to the cell suspension after 8 min.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells with 1.5 mL pre-warmed EVT1 medium.
Pipette the cells evenly and count the cell number using the cell count chamber.
Seed 4×10^5 hTSPS cells per well on the matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Add EVT1 medium to a total of 2 mL per well for 3 days at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove EVT1 medium after 3 days and add EVT2 medium for the next 3 days.
Collect EVT cells on day 6 to 8 for analysis.
Repeat steps 38a-d for STB differentiation, but resuspend cells with 1.5 mL pre-warmed STB medium.
Seed 1×10^5 hTSPS cells per well on the matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Add STB medium to a total of 2 mL per well for 3 days at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the fresh STB medium for the next 3 days.
Collect STB cells on day 6 for analysis.
